summary: A Quote subscription survives the broker dropping the socket: the feed logs in again, subscribes the touchline again, and the snapshot Noren answers with is served.

notes: The desktop drops its cached snapshots on a new connection (appendix item 11); the web's TradeSmart adapter keeps them. A full snapshot follows every subscribe, so both serve the same frame here.

deviations.reason: The web's TradeSmart adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).

The stream carries no OI for this instrument (a cash equity or an index); the web's TradeSmart adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
